summary: Well-executed, preregistered paired controlled-fault experiment addressing a clear gap (verifier-guided repair for vendor-CLI configs). Execution artifacts, preregistration, paired design (shared initial candidate), accounting, and primary paired analysis are complete and internally consistent. Primary result (n=39 pairs: baseline 30/39 vs guarded 38/39; discordants n10=9, n01=1; exact paired p=0.02148; 95% CI reported) appears correctly computed from archived contingency counts. The study is reproducible given the archived artifact bundle, but the manuscript requires specific documentation and citation-format corrections before finalisation.
critical_issues: References and in-text citations are not presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography. The manuscript currently lists raw DOI/identifier strings (and informal named citations) rather than a full IEEE-formatted reference list; this violates the conference/track requirement and the developer review constraints and prevents verification that each cited source supports the proximate claims.
required_revisions: Replace all in-text citations with standard IEEE numbered markers and include a conventional IEEE-formatted References section (authors, title, venue, year, DOI/arXiv) for every cited work. Do not use bare DOI/arXiv/identifier entries in the References or prose.

Provide a verified-bibliography record (or addendum) mapping each in-text numbered citation to the exact bibliographic metadata and a one-line justification that the cited item supports the nearby claim wherever the claim depends on that source (this can be supplementary material archived with the artifact bundle).

Condense the Disclosure Statement so it is concise and non-redundant (remove execution-log-level detail and per-file inventory from the manuscript Disclosure while preserving the single mandatory master-prompt archive locator and its SHA‑256). The shorter Disclosure must still state model(s), adapter, autonomy boundary, preregistration id, and that no manual manuscript edits occurred post-lock.

In Methods, explicitly state the runtime sampling semantics exactly as archived (model_configuration.temperature = null/unset) and add the preregistered statement that null/unset is not evidence of deterministic sampling; also explicitly confirm that exactly one sampled initial generation per pair was performed and reused by both arms (shared_initial_candidate semantics) and point to the archived artifact(s) and their hashes that show this accounting.
optional_revisions: Add a short table or appendix (in the artifact bundle or as a small figure) summarising exploratory per-fault-class outcomes to aid reader interpretation (labelled exploratory).
Shorten/streamline the Related Work section to the closest 4–6 references (after converting to IEEE numbering) to help meet page limits and increase focus on nearest prior work.

Add a brief paragraph clarifying power/precision interpretation given the preregistered planning target (~30 pp) versus the observed estimate (~20 pp) to avoid reader confusion about planning assumptions vs observed statistical evidence.
